title: Async API Client
target_skills: Request remote JSON, parse results, handle status codes, and apply timeouts.
prompt: Implement “Async API Client” in Dart. Request remote JSON, parse results, handle status codes, and apply timeouts. Work locally and keep the learner-facing implementation independent of external services unless the prompt explicitly requires a network boundary.
inputs_or_scenario: Use normal, empty/malformed, and boundary inputs relevant to: Request remote JSON, parse results, handle status codes, and apply timeouts.
expected_output_or_acceptance: Request remote JSON, parse results, handle status codes, and apply timeouts.
Document at least one representative expected result and one invalid/boundary input.
Keep public behavior and error handling reproducible in tests.
hints: List the inputs and expected outputs before coding.
Separate input parsing, the core transformation, and output formatting.
Add a boundary case and test the failure contract rather than silently ignoring it.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation covers each skill named in the exercise prompt.
Invalid or boundary input is handled deliberately.
The implementation is readable, formatted, and locally testable.
A short test or transcript records expected behavior.
grading_method: Token presence is only a lightweight smoke check. Verify semantics with local Dart tests and the acceptance rubric; CodeLeaf does not execute arbitrary Dart submissions.

retry_policy.feedback: Use the first unmet acceptance criterion to guide a focused revision.
retry_policy.xp_policy: Platform-wide completion rules apply; no course-specific reward override.

status_note: Exercise is based on Section C of the attached Dart curriculum and requires human review before publication.
